purpose: Build ChugGate: a performance-aware adaptive gate, downward expander, and multiband noise controller for electric guitar and bass. C++20/JUCE plugin targeting VST3 and Standalone with external sidechain input. 8-state performance engine, DI key alignment with fractional delay, Pick Attack Guard, Sustain Intelligence with lightweight fundamental estimator, Feedback Friend, Riff Cadence Engine, Noise Learn, multiband gating with Hiss Curtain, attack/tail integrity analysis, and Performance Timeline diagnostic GUI. Full product specification in CHUGGATE_SPEC.md.
async_strategy: Phases run sequentially. Within each phase, tasks with disjoint write paths run in parallel waves. Fan-in tasks (processBlock wiring, editor integration) depend on all upstream tasks in the same phase and are the sole owner of CMakeLists.txt, PluginProcessor, and PluginEditor within that phase. The C++ language adapter provides cmake/ctest verification inference — task verification_commands arrays are left empty.

phases.goal:
Project scaffold, build system, APVTS parameter infrastructure, and state engine.

Create the ChugGate JUCE plugin project. Inspect ShredBoost and ShredSpace CMakeLists.txt for known-working structure and follow same conventions for plugin code, manufacturer code, company name, bundle ID, version, copy-after-build.

CMakeLists.txt: juce_add_plugin targeting VST3 + Standalone. CMakePresets.json, scripts/build_all.sh, JUCE as git submodule.

PluginProcessor: configure main input bus, optional sidechain input bus, and output through AudioProcessor::BusesProperties. Implement isBusesLayoutSupported for mono, stereo, and stereo+sidechain layouts. Standalone must operate safely without external sidechain. processBlock stub, state save/restore with schema versioning.

ParameterIDs.h: complete stable v1.0 parameter inventory. Global: enabled, mode (Chug/Lead/Hybrid/Manual), topology (FullBand/DualBand/TriBand/HissCurtain), gainMode (HardGate/SoftGate/DownwardExpander), thresholdOpen (-100 to 0dBFS), hysteresis (0.5-24dB — thresholdClose is DERIVED as open-hysteresis, not stored), attack, hold, release, maxAdaptiveRelease, floor, ratio, knee, curve, lookahead, outputTrim, bypass. Key: source, externalBlend, hpfEnabled, hpfFrequency, hpfSlope, lpfEnabled, lpfFrequency, lpfSlope, emphasisFreq, emphasisGain, emphasisQ, humMode (off/50Hz/60Hz/auto), humHarmonics, humNotchQ, humImmunityAmount, alignmentOffset, fallbackMode, listenMode. AttackGuard: enabled, amount, sensitivity, frequency, decay, softNoteAssist, maxThresholdReduction, confirmationWindow. Sustain: enabled, amount, releaseExtension, harmonicWeight, decayWeight, noiseWeight, feedbackEnabled, feedbackSensitivity, feedbackMinDuration, feedbackMaxHold, feedbackFreqMin, feedbackFreqMax, feedbackFloor, feedbackRequireExtKey, feedbackSafetyTimeout. Cadence: enabled, amount, releaseFraction, sourceMode (audio/hostTempo/combined/off). Noise learn: snrMargin, adaptiveEnabled, adaptiveRate. Per-band (low/mid/high): floor, thresholdOffset, attackOffset, holdOffset, releaseMultiplier, solo, mute, detectorWeighting. HissCurtain: minFreq, maxFreq, depth. Stereo: linkMode, linkAmount. Crossovers: dualFreq, triLowFreq, triHighFreq. Audition: rejectedMode (off/all/fullBand/weight/voice/hiss/hissCurtain/noiseModel/key), stateFilterMode (off/hold/sustain/release/closed). Profile and tuning index. A/B state.

State engine: XML state with schema_version, A/B slots, learned noise profile storage, DI alignment result storage, factory presets from Resources/Presets/ (read-only), user presets via per-user app data.

phases.goal:
Pick Attack Guard, Sustain Intelligence with lightweight fundamental estimator, and Feedback Friend.

See CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 8-10 for complete DSP math.

AttackGuard: band-limited transient detection with false-trigger protection.

Lightweight fundamental estimator (Source/DSP/FundamentalEstimator.h/.cpp): required by SustainAnalyzer and FeedbackDetector for harmonicity calculation. Use bounded autocorrelation or harmonic product spectrum — does NOT need full YIN/note tracking (that's ShredEQ territory). Must produce: estimatedFundamental, confidence, timestamp, validity. Runs at decimated control rate.

SustainAnalyzer: harmonicity using FundamentalEstimator f0, spectral stability, decay slope. Composite sustain score. Adaptive release.

FeedbackDetector: harmonic confidence, safety bounds mandatory.

Integrate all into PerformanceStateMachine.

phases.goal:
Analyzer system: Performance Timeline data, Noise Fingerprint, DI Alignment Scope, Attack Integrity, Tail Integrity, and analysis FIFO.

AnalysisFifo (Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h/.cpp): lock-free SPSC via juce::AbstractFifo. Carries all analysis data. Skip frames, fixed memory.

PerformanceHistory (Source/Analysis/PerformanceHistory.h/.cpp): ring buffer for timeline — envelopes, thresholds, noise floor, state lane, gain, transients, sustain confidence. History 2-30s.

NoiseFingerprint (Source/Analysis/NoiseFingerprint.h/.cpp): time-averaged spectral display of learned noise.

AlignmentScopeData (Source/Analysis/AlignmentScopeData.h/.cpp): key/main onset waveforms, correlation curve, offset, confidence.

AttackIntegrityAnalyzer (Source/Analysis/AttackIntegrityAnalyzer.h/.cpp): per-onset attack preservation ratio A_r = sum(y²)/sum(x²) over attack window. Summarizes preserved/partial/missed attacks. Uses data already collected by Performance Timeline.

TailIntegrityAnalyzer (Source/Analysis/TailIntegrityAnalyzer.h/.cpp): per-tail comparison of main decay vs output decay vs sustain confidence vs closure point. Makes lead-note choking visible.

All on background/message thread. Quality modes: Off, Live, Studio, Diagnose.
